name: Fujimura Natsuki
source:
Kanade's friend and classmate. Extremely shy and reserved, even when she speaks her voice is quiet. She normally does not show any emotion, no one knows what is is usually thinking about.

To Natsuki, Kanade is the most important person to her as she is her only friend in the entire grade, so she is very unhappy about the bullying Kanade gets.
